name: Loose blocks
lesson: When a block's genes are spread over the chromosome, one-point crossover cuts through its blocks far more often, so good blocks are broken faster than they can be assembled.
lookFor: In the crossover view a cut anywhere between gene 5 and gene 15 splits all five blocks (11 of the 19 possible cuts). With this seed and 50 individuals the run ends without finding 20 (best so far 17); the same seed with tight blocks finds 20 in generation 74. Over seeds 1 to 100, tight blocks find 20 in 32 runs and loose blocks in none.
